title: What the Fuck Happened to Nerds
summary: This is a cultural commentary piece examining how nerds and tech culture evolved from being socially marginalized outsiders to becoming mainstream influencers who now shape society, business, and politics. The article explores the societal shift that brought 'nerd culture' from the fringes to the center of modern life.
problem_solved: Provides cultural insight into the transformation of nerds from social outcasts to influential figures in contemporary society.
why_valuable: The high engagement (549 points, 334 comments) demonstrates this resonates strongly with the tech community, sparking meaningful discussion about identity, culture, and social change.
